specs.title: cp-000: Ungroup CtrlShiftG Ungroups selected group
cp-001: Zoom In Increments zoom by 01
cp-002: Zoom Out - Decrements zoom by 01
cp-003: Zoom to 100 Ctrl0 Resets viewport to 10
cp-004: Fit to Window Ctrl1 Fits all objects in view
cp-005: Zoom presets 50 100 150 200 Each sets zoom to value
cp-006: Show Grid Ctrl Toggles gridVisible
cp-007: Snap to Grid CtrlShift Toggles snapToGrid
cp-008: Show Rulers CtrlR Toggles ruler visibility
cp-009: Show Guides CtrlShiftR Toggles guide visibility
cp-010: Bring to Front CtrlShift Moves selected to top z-index
cp-011: Bring Forward Ctrl Increases z-index by 1
cp-012: Send Backward Ctrl Decreases z-index by 1
cp-013: Send to Back CtrlShift Moves selected to bottom z-index
cp-014: Flip Horizontal ShiftH Flips selection horizontally
cp-015: Flip Vertical ShiftV Flips selection vertically
cp-016: Group CtrlG Groups selected objects
cp-017: Ungroup CtrlShiftG Ungroups selected group
cp-018: Make Clipping Mask Ctrl7 Requires 2 objects selected
cp-019: Release Clipping Mask CtrlAlt7 Requires single clipped group
cp-020: Make Compound Path Ctrl8 Requires 2 path objects
cp-021: Release Compound Path CtrlAlt8 Requires single compound path
cp-022: Offset Path Prompts for distance positive outward negative inward
cp-023: Pathfinder Unite Combines shapes into one
cp-024: Pathfinder Subtract Cuts bottom shape from top
cp-025: Pathfinder Intersect Keeps only overlapping area
cp-026: Pathfinder Exclude XOR keeps non-overlapping areas
cp-027: DNA Helix CtrlShiftD Inserts DNA helix shape
cp-028: Cell Membrane CtrlShiftM Inserts cell membrane shape
cp-029: Cell Layer Tissue Inserts tissue layer shape
cp-030: Neuron Inserts neuron shape
cp-031: Mitochondria Inserts mitochondria shape
cp-032: Pathway Arrows Inserts pathway arrow set
cp-033: All Scientific Shapes CtrlShiftS Opens full shape generator panel
cp-034: AI Generate Image CtrlShiftA Opens AIGenerationTool dialog
